spec._note: max_hours: screen-eval-gsm50k-main (silent-eval-20261020-112122-f7da): in-VM 2026-10-20T11:27:07Z..2026-10-20T11:49:43Z = 1356 s / 45 entries = 30.1 s per entry (ledger close runtime 2056 s incl. boot) (500 valid items per entry at max_new_tokens 64); x 300/500 (valid items) x 128/64 (token budget) = 36.2 s per entry. Assumption: an entry's in-VM time is linear in its item count and in max_new_tokens (decode-bound; a generation that stops before the budget costs less, and the per-entry download and model load are scaled too, so both factors err long); prosqa_hard's longer prompts (one prefill pass) and its latent count are not scaled separately; the entry mix (45 entries, 3 batch-1 timed reads) is screen-eval-gsm50k-main's, so its per-entry mean transfers. 45 entries x 36.2 s = 1627 s = 0.452 h; 1.3 x 0.452 + 0.5 = 1.088 h, up to the half hour: 1.5 h (refused above 2.5 h). Numerics: the screen checkpoints' own (A10.1, A10.5): bf16 autocast from each config on TF32 flags on (--tf32 on from tf32 true; the job's precision field carries the flags, the config the autocast: summary.json's precision is the config's, its numerics run_eval.py's set_tf32 readback). A6.2 rule 3's strict-fp32 logits check is not in this job (rule 3 logits check pending). Checkpoints: screen-prosqa-hard-acctb on acctb, each pinned by RUN_DONE.json and checked against the screen table's selected epoch_index. The latent arms train from the pinned base model (no load_model_path, A3.4.5): no start checkpoint to pin; a RUN_DONE.json with an init pin is refused. Trained n_latent 7 (max_latent_stage x c_thought); the step sweep {0, 1, 2, 4, 8} (A3.4's standing controls), n above the trained n labelled out of distribution in its entry (the largest n fits GPT-2's 1024 positions with the longest valid question, the manifest's context_cap). Valid: data/prosqa_hard_valid.json (300 items, the manifest's screen block), max_new_tokens 128; main's bucket (silent/data/) must hold data/prosqa_hard_train.json, data/prosqa_hard_valid.json, data/prosqa_hard_test.json (the VM verifies every file of the task; the read opens valid only).
